_comment: Extend Parse configuration for the building code book (NOT for drawings — those use extract.config.json). Consumed by scripts/extend_parse_code.py, which writes parsed sections into data/ for lib/ingest-core.ts to embed. Docs: https://docs.extend.ai/parsing/configuration
_comment_chunking: Section chunking splits on the document's own markdown structure, which is what lib/chunker.ts approximates with regex over raw pdf-parse text. Letting the parser do it keeps clause boundaries intact instead of guessing them from line shapes. Bounds are sized for one code article per chunk.

blockOptions._comment_tables: The code's numeric limits live in tables — Table 9.8.4.1 is the source for the stair rise and run rules in data/nbc-rules.json. Markdown keeps them readable in an embedded chunk, and header continuation keeps the column meanings attached when a table runs across pages, which the long dimension tables do.

figures.customInstructions: Figures in this document are building-code diagrams: stair sections, guard and handrail details, egress plans, and spatial separation diagrams. Describe the dimensions and limits each figure illustrates, and name the article number it belongs to when the caption gives one.
